messages:
hana_marketing: Quick design request for the "Inference Playbook" webinar next Thurs — need a compact, reusable asset kit we can drop into slides, social, and the registration page. :rocket:
hana_marketing: Deliverables (priority order): 1) hero static (1600x900) + 3s looping GIF, 2) interactive HTML microcard (embed-ready, 600x400) + PNG/SVG fallback, 3) three micro-tiles (1080x1080, 1200x628, 320x480), 4) inbound swimlane routing diagram (1200x600) with visible CRM tag, 5) one-sheet pacing timeline for hosts. Also need alt text for all assets and light/dark variants.
eli_design: Interesting — interactive microcard adds dev work. We can hand off an HTML prototype + annotated CSS vars. Any animation constraints?
hana_marketing: Keep microcard animation minimal (CSS transform, <10kb JS). Microcard should show a looping sparkline + token-pulse. Export targets: SVG + PNG@2x + minified HTML.
ben_growth: CTA variants: Paid: "Register now" (use bold accent). Organic: "Watch the webinar". For micro-tiles add a paid overlay option.
sam_prod: Routing details for swimlane: registration form -> lead scoring service -> premium queue (score>=85) OR standard queue -> AE assignment. After 48h unassigned -> SDR pool. CRM field: "inference_use_case" must be displayed. Public labels: use "Premium" and "Standard" only. JSON if helpful: {"lead_source":"webinar","score_threshold":85,"routing":"premium|standard|SDR"} 
claire_legal: Flag on comparative claims. Send exact hero wording and benchmark lines and Ill review within 24h. Any use of "Xx cheaper" or specific multiples needs a source callout or "typical workloads" qualifier.
eli_design: Got it. We'll draft two hero headline comps and one benchmark graphic with the qualifier. Any preference on tone? More visual-data-forward or product-forward?
hana_marketing: Data-forward but approachable. Include a small methodology callout: "Simulated conversational routing; median latency ~60ms; caching + batching reduces unit cost ~2.6x (typical)." Mark as illustrative.
asset-bot: Uploaded figma://inference-microkit/2891234567 (preview https://figma-preview.example/2891234567) :white_check_mark:
eli_design: Timeline: thumbnails tonight, first-pass files by Mon 11:00 PT (hero + microcard prototype + routing sketch), banners + tiles by Mon 16:00. Will add figma notes for alt text and export presets.
ben_growth: Please label frames with CTA variant (paid/organic) and language code (EN). Also add a 600x200 paid ad.
eli_design: Adding 600x200 and a 1:1 crop (1080x1080). Will include an accessibility check (4.5:1 contrast for CTAs) and suggested alt text.
claire_legal: Once hero copy is in the figma, tag me and Ill quick-review. If you include any comparative visuals, add the small footer: "Data shown for illustration only."
hana_marketing: One more: include a speaker cue sheet (one-pager) with slide callouts and suggested prompts for live Q&A.
eli_design: Noted — will create a simple 2-column cue sheet. Anything else?
hana_marketing: Nope, thanks. Priorities: hero + microcard + routing diagram. Tag me on updates. :sparkles:
